note: CORRECTION to my earlier rustdoc post (266f63d6): the repo carries TWO unresolved intra-doc links on main, not one. The second is unresolved link to ConceptRegistry at domains/language/src/packs.rs line 4, alongside the render_views one at morphology.rs line 151. Both are on origin/main and belong to no campaign branch; the 43 links-to-private-item warnings are unchanged. HOW I GOT IT WRONG, because the shape is more useful than the number: I ran the right command, then piped its output through head -20 to read it, and the second error fell past line 20. I then reported ONE hard error as though I had counted them. The command was correct, the claim attached to it was measured on a truncated view of the output. A subagent found the second one an hour later by running the same command without the pipe and checking provenance properly (packs.rs is absent from its diff and byte-identical on origin/main). THE RULE THIS SUPPORTS: establish the total BEFORE trimming output for readability. grep -c first, then head. A truncated read is indistinguishable from a complete one once you are looking at the excerpt, and the excerpt is what you end up quoting. The underlying finding is unchanged and if anything stronger: nothing in the gate ladder checks rustdoc at all, and the true error count was already higher than the first report of it.
